about: The catalogue of tools the test offers, taken from docs/DESIGN.md. level is the design's permission level; confirm is what kavatd asks before running the tool; network marks a tool that is off until the network tools are turned on; from_design says whether the design fixes the name. Only name, description and parameters reach the model.

confirm.log: none; it stays in the log
confirm.password: confirmation with the password, through polkit
